# time cockpit

> time cockpit is a flexible, customizable time tracking and project management solution by software architects gmbh. It combines a graphical time sheet calendar, project-based time tracking, attendance and leave management, invoicing, and reporting with deep customization options: a customizable data model, the Time Cockpit Query Language (TCQL), Python scripting, and an OData/REST Web API.

This is the official product documentation at https://docs.timecockpit.com. Links point to the raw Markdown sources; the rendered HTML version of every page is available at the same URL with .html instead of .md. A concatenated plain-text version of the complete documentation is available at https://docs.timecockpit.com/llms-full.txt.

## For Users

- [For Users - Overview](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/for-users.md): Entry page for user documentation about time tracking, project work, absences, invoicing, and reporting in time cockpit.

- [Overview](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/overview.md): Flexible time tracking and project management with graphical calendar, attendance tracking, and deep customization for businesses of all sizes.

- [Mobile & Responsive Access](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/mobile-guide.md): Complete guide to using time cockpit on mobile devices including phones and tablets. Learn about responsive web access, mobile workflows, tips for on-the-go time tracking, and PWA installation.

- [Project Management - Budgetary Control (Technical)](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/use-cases/budgetary-control.md): Deep dive into time cockpit's budgetary control lists - how metrics are calculated, what data sources are used, and how to build similar custom reports.
- [Invoicing & Billing - Invoice Creation](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/project-time-tracking/billing.md): Learn how to create invoices from time sheet entries in time cockpit. Generate invoice items automatically, use articles, create manual invoices, and generate PDF reports.
- [Invoicing & Billing - Invoice Data Fields](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/project-time-tracking/invoice-data-fields.md): Learn about invoice data fields in time cockpit including invoice date, number, billing address, service period, and invoice items configuration.
- [Invoicing & Billing - Hourly Rate Management](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/project-time-tracking/hourly-rates.md): Complete guide to configuring hourly rates for billing, understanding rate hierarchy, managing customer-specific pricing, role-based rates, and rate change workflows in time cockpit.

- [Employee Management - Absence Management](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/employee-time-tracking/absence-time-management.md): Manage vacation, sick leave, and compensatory time in time cockpit. Track absence time, calculate remaining leave, and manage entitlements.
- [Employee Management - Prorated Vacation](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/employee-time-tracking/prorated-vacation.md): How time cockpit prorates vacation entitlements that have not yet reached a full year since their entitlement date.
- [Employee Management - Approval Workflows](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/employee-time-tracking/approval-workflows.md): Complete guide to approval workflows in time cockpit including absence approvals (vacation, sick leave, compensatory time), timesheet approvals, role-based permissions, and automated notifications.
- [Employee Management - Working Time Regulations](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/employee-time-tracking/working-time-regulations.md): Configure working time limits and regulations in time cockpit for Austria and Germany. Monitor violations, breaks, resting periods, and daily/weekly limits.
- [Time Tracking - Time Sheet Calendar](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/timesheet-calendar/calendar.md): Master time cockpit's graphical calendar interface. Learn day, week, and month views, navigation, zoom controls, and user selection for time tracking.
- [Time Tracking - Working With Entries](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/timesheet-calendar/working-with-timesheet-entries.md): Learn how to create, edit, copy, move, and delete time sheet entries in time cockpit's calendar. Includes drag-and-drop, keyboard shortcuts, and formatting.
- [Time Tracking - Timesheet Templates](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/timesheet-calendar/timesheet-templates.md): Create and use time sheet templates in time cockpit to streamline time tracking. Save recurring tasks as templates for quick application.
- [Reporting - Overview](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/reporting/overview.md): Create printable reports in time cockpit using Microsoft Reporting Services (SSRS). Learn about RDL files, report filters, and data sources for custom reports.
- [Reporting - Built-In Reports](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/reporting/built-in-reports.md): Access time cockpit's built-in reports including sales trend, revenue per customer, and time reports. Pre-configured SSRS reports.

## For Users: Full Client (Desktop)

- [Installation Instructions](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/installation-instructions.md): Learn how to install time cockpit on Windows. Get system requirements, installation wizard instructions, and IT administrator deployment guidelines.
- [Configuration Wizard](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/configuration-wizard.md): Learn how to configure time cockpit using the configuration wizard. Set up language, credentials, sync settings, and signal trackers.
- [System Architecture](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/system-architecture.md): Learn about time cockpit's system architecture. Understand offline capabilities, data synchronization, client and server data stores, and SQL Azure integration.
- [Troubleshooting - Send Log Files](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/troubleshooting/send-log-files.md): Gather and send log files from time cockpit for troubleshooting. Learn about log file locations, formats, and log levels.
- [Troubleshooting - Force Initial Sync](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/troubleshooting/force-initial-sync.md): Force an initial synchronization in time cockpit to reset your local database. Resolve sync errors and restore from server database.
- [Troubleshooting - SqlCeLockTimeoutException](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/troubleshooting/sql-ce-lock-timeout-exception.md): Resolve SqlCeLockTimeoutException in time cockpit. Fix database locks by restarting the full client and signal tracker.
- [Troubleshooting - Signal Tracking Suspended](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/troubleshooting/signal-tracking-suspended.md): Resolve signal tracking suspension in time cockpit caused by system time changes. Correct system clock and restart signal trackers.
- [Troubleshooting - Network related error](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/troubleshooting/network-related-error.md): Troubleshoot network-related errors in time cockpit. Fix SQL Server connection issues, timeouts, and firewall configuration problems.
- [Troubleshooting - CryptographicException](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/troubleshooting/next-button-missing-configuration-wizard.md): Fix CryptographicException errors in time cockpit. Resolve missing Next button in configuration wizard by removing invalid data protection keys.
- [How To - Reset Password](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/getting-started/howtos/reset-password.md): Reset your time cockpit password via the web client. Follow the password reset process using your registered email address.
- [Signal Trackers - Overview](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/overview.md): Learn about time cockpit's signal trackers that automatically track PC activities like computer activity, user activity, emails, phone calls, and more to simplify time tracking.
- [Signal Trackers - Signals](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/timesheet-calendar/signals.md): Understand how signals work in time cockpit's calendar. Learn about duration signals, point signals, combined activities, and how to use them for accurate time tracking.
- [Signal Trackers - Signal Details](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/timesheet-calendar/signal-details.md): Analyze detailed signal data in time cockpit's signal details pane. View applications, changed files, window titles, keywords, and network connections.
- [Signal Trackers - Options](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/options.md): Configure signal tracker startup and processing options in time cockpit. Set break lengths, phone call minimums, and auto-start settings.
- [Signal Trackers - Computer Activity](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/computer-activity.md): Track when your computer is turned on and off with time cockpit's computer activity signal tracker. Monitor system uptime and power states.
- [Signal Trackers - User Activity](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/user-activity.md): Track keyboard and mouse activity in time cockpit to identify working time. Monitor user interactions and detect breaks automatically.
- [Signal Trackers - Active Windows](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/active-windows.md): Track active applications and window titles in time cockpit. Monitor which programs you're using to identify projects and customers.
- [Signal Trackers - Sent Emails](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/sent-emails.md): Track emails sent with Microsoft Office Outlook in time cockpit. Identify when work packages are completed and sent to customers.
- [Signal Trackers - Changed Files](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/changed-files.md): Track file writes on your computer with time cockpit's changed files signal tracker. Monitor file activity to identify projects and customers.
- [Signal Trackers - Network Connections](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/network-connections.md): Track LAN and Wi-Fi network connections in time cockpit. Identify work locations by monitoring connected and available networks.
- [Signal Trackers - Notes](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/notes.md): Capture lightweight notes about your work in time cockpit. Use keyboard shortcuts or automatic prompts after breaks.
- [Signal Trackers - Phone Calls](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/phone-calls.md): Import phone call history from mobile phones into time cockpit. Support for Android, iPhone, and legacy devices via XML export.
- [Signal Trackers - Team Foundation Server](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/team-foundation-server.md): Track Microsoft Team Foundation Server change sets and work item changes in time cockpit. Monitor developer activity and code commits.
- [Signal Trackers - Import Signals From Text Files](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/signal-tracker/import-signals.md): Import custom signals from CSV files into time cockpit. Contact support for assistance with signal import functionality.

- [Feature Flags](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/data-model-customization/feature-flags.md): Learn how time cockpit uses feature flags and namespacing to ensure compatibility between standard functionality and customer customizations.
- [Migration Guide Default Permissions](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/migration-guides/default-permissions.md): Migrate to time cockpit's new default permissions system. Learn about feature flags, activation scenarios, and compatibility for existing customers.

## For Developers: Time Cockpit Query Language (TCQL)

- [Overview](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/tcql/overview.md): Learn time cockpit's query language (TCQL) similar to LINQ. Query data, use aggregation functions, sub-queries, and integrate with IronPython scripts and .NET applications.
- [From Clause](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/tcql/from-clause.md): Learn how to define query sources in time cockpit's TCQL using the from clause. Includes entity selection, relation includes, and examples.
- [Where Clause](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/tcql/where-clause.md): Learn how to use the where clause in time cockpit's TCQL query language to filter data. Includes examples and expression language usage.
- [Order By Clause](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/tcql/order-by-clause.md): Sort query results in time cockpit's TCQL using the order by clause. Learn ascending and descending sort order with examples.
- [Select Clause](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/tcql/select-clause.md): Define query result structure in time cockpit's TCQL. Learn about select clauses, anonymous types, and version info for data synchronization.
- [Expression Language](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/tcql/expression-language.md): Learn time cockpit's TCQL expression language for queries, calculated properties, and validation rules. Includes operators, functions, and examples.
- [Functions for Working Time and Holidays](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/tcql/functions-for-working-time-and-holidays.md): Use TCQL functions in time cockpit to calculate planned working hours, remaining vacation weeks, overtime, and actual hours of work.
- [TCQL AST API](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/tcql/tcql-ast-api.md): Create TCQL queries programmatically in time cockpit using the Abstract Syntax Tree API. Build queries with code instead of strings.

## For Developers: Scripting & Automation

- [Overview](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/overview.md): Automate time cockpit tasks with IronPython scripts. Learn to modify data models, create interfaces, customize UI, and run batch processes using the built-in script editor.
- [Automating Scripts](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/automating-scripts.md): Automate IronPython script execution in time cockpit using ExecuteScript. Schedule scripts, use transactions, and integrate with external systems.
- [Actions](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/actions.md): Create custom actions in time cockpit using IronPython. Learn about action structure, conditions, parameters, and execution context for workflows.
- [Triggers](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/triggers.md): Create triggers in time cockpit to automatically execute code when records are inserted, updated, or deleted. Advanced automation concept.
- [How To - Add a File Property](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/add-file-property.md): Add file attachment properties to entities in time cockpit. Learn how to store file content, metadata, and display files in lists and forms.
- [How To - Add Holidays Using a Script](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/add-holidays.md): Automatically insert floating and fixed holidays in time cockpit using IronPython scripts. Example code for holiday management.
- [How To - Export Data to Microsoft Excel](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/export-data-to-excel.md): Export data from time cockpit to Microsoft Excel using built-in functions or Office automation. Create pivot tables and formatted reports.
- [How To - Import Data From CSV](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/import-data-from-csv.md): Import data from CSV files into time cockpit using IronPython scripts. Learn how to use .NET CSV libraries and handle CSV data.
- [How To - Import Data From SQL Server](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/import-data-from-sql-server.md): Import data from external SQL Server databases into time cockpit using IronPython and ADO.NET. Access remote databases and sync data.
- [How To - Modify the Data Model](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/modify-data-model.md): Modify time cockpit's data model using IronPython scripts. Add properties, entities, relations, and calculated properties programmatically.
- [How To - Send Mails When a Project is Over Budget](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/send-mail-when-over-budget.md): Automatically send emails in time cockpit when projects exceed budget using IronPython scripts. Example code for budget monitoring.
- [How To - Use .NET Framework Classes in Scripts](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/use-dot-net-classes-in-scripts.md): Use .NET Framework classes in IronPython scripts for time cockpit. Access .NET libraries, generics, and advanced features from Python.
- [How To - Use C# to Access Time Cockpit API](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/use-c-sharp-to-access-time-cockpit-api.md): Access time cockpit's API from C# and other .NET languages. Learn about project references, data context, and server data store connections.
- [How To - Use XML in Scripts](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/scripting/use-xml-in-scripts.md): Use XML and .NET XML classes in IronPython scripts for time cockpit. Build form definitions and UI elements programmatically.

## For Developers: Web API

- [Overview](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/web-api/overview.md): Access time cockpit data via REST API with OData, query endpoints, and action execution. Integrate with PowerBI, Excel, and custom applications.
- [Authentication](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/web-api/authentication.md): Learn how to authenticate with time cockpit's Web API using PAT (Personal Access Tokens), token authentication, or basic authentication. Includes code examples.
- [OData Endpoint](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/web-api/odata.md): Learn how to use time cockpit's OData endpoint to query, insert, update, and delete data. Includes examples for C#, TypeScript, and other client technologies.
- [Query Endpoint](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/web-api/query.md): Execute TCQL queries via time cockpit's query endpoint. Learn when to use it over OData, see REST and C# examples for complex queries and joins.
- [ExecuteList Endpoint](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/web-api/executelist.md): Execute time cockpit lists via Web API. Query TCQL lists and script lists for data analysis, working time violations, and project controlling.
- [ExecuteAction Endpoint](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/web-api/executeaction.md): Execute time cockpit actions via Web API. Run custom IronPython business logic, webhooks, and automate routine tasks programmatically.
- [Reporting Endpoint](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/web-api/reporting.md): Generate time cockpit SSRS reports via Web API in PDF, Word, or Excel format. Fetch time reports and custom reports programmatically.
- [Sample Implementation TimeCockpitClient](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/web-api/timecockpit-client.md): Sample implementation of TimeCockpitClient class for time cockpit Web API. Includes OData, query endpoint, and POCO mapping examples.

## For Developers: MCP Server (AI Assistants)

- [Overview](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/overview.md): Overview of the time cockpit MCP server, its endpoints, authentication with Microsoft Entra ID, per-connection settings, and the supported AI clients.
- [Entra ID Setup](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/entra-id-setup.md): Register a client application for the time cockpit MCP server in your own Microsoft Entra ID tenant - platform, redirect URIs, API permission, admin consent - and hand the client ID to your users.
- [Claude Code](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/claude-code.md): Register the time cockpit MCP server in Claude Code, sign in with Microsoft Entra ID, verify the connection, and share the configuration with your team via .mcp.json.
- [Claude App, claude.ai & Cowork](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/claude-app.md): Add the time cockpit MCP server as a custom connector in claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Claude Mobile, and Cowork, using your organization's OAuth client ID and URL segments instead of headers.
- [OpenAI Codex](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/codex.md): Register the time cockpit MCP server in OpenAI Codex (CLI, desktop app, IDE extension) with codex mcp add or config.toml, sign in with Microsoft Entra ID, and troubleshoot common errors.
- [ChatGPT (Web, Business & Enterprise)](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/chatgpt.md): Register the time cockpit MCP server as a custom app in a ChatGPT Business or Enterprise workspace, publish it to all members, let every user sign in with Microsoft Entra ID, and import the companion skills as a plugin marketplace from GitHub.
- [Visual Studio Code](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/vscode.md): Configure the time cockpit MCP server in Visual Studio Code for GitHub Copilot agent mode via mcp.json, including OAuth client ID, header inputs, Microsoft authentication, and troubleshooting.
- [MCPJam Inspector](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/mcpjam.md): Connect the time cockpit MCP server to MCPJam Inspector before integrating it into an AI client, configure OAuth and sandbox headers, and run read-only diagnostic tests.
- [Verify the Connection](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/verify-connection.md): Check a time cockpit MCP connection with the ping, get_environment, get_current_user, and entra_whoami tools, understand why tools may be missing, and compare configuration fields across clients.
- [Access, Scope, and Confirmation](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/access-and-confirmation.md): How the time cockpit MCP server restricts what an AI agent may do - the read-only access mode, the own-data scope, permission enforcement, and the confirmation handshake for changes.
- [Limits and Truncation](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/limits.md): What the row and size limits of the time cockpit MCP server mean, how to read a truncated result, why a list description can be derived from a sample, and which operations cannot be cancelled.
- [Companion Skills & APM](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/companion-skills.md): Install the timecockpit-agents companion skills with Microsoft APM so AI assistants know how to connect to time cockpit, query with TCQL, book time, and run lists and actions.
- [OnCockpit Admin (Local MCP Server)](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/mcp/oncockpit-admin-local.md): Run the local time cockpit MCP server built into OnCockpit Admin over stdio, register it in Claude Code, VS Code or Codex, and use IronPython scripting for data model roundtrips, test data and automated tests.

- [Custom Reports](https://docs.timecockpit.com/doc/reporting/custom-reports.md): Create and integrate custom SSRS reports in time cockpit. Download report definitions, customize with Report Builder, and upload reports.
